cuts.label: scout:jerma985+pokelawls/jerma985-pokelawls-bike-charact-2026w41
cuts.title: Jerma tries to fuel a bike in GTA RP and it explodes
cuts.hook: Jerma tries to fuel a bike
cuts.retelling: Jerma clumsily tries to fuel a bike at a GTA RP pump, calling for Donnie, and it bursts into flames. Pokelawls's stream then shows the same fire, and the bike turns out to be his.

cuts.hook: Cinna thinks the getaway was genius

cuts.hook: Emiru's cat Cheddar keeps getting skinnier
cuts.retelling: Emiru jokes that her one pet is getting fat while Cheddar gets skinnier, then realizes she let the clingy Cheddar outside, guesses he's out terrorizing a neighbor's cat, hears that cat yell, and runs off to deal with it.

cuts.label: loltyler1@vod2895330132/loltyler1-along-draft-2026w41
